name: Bank Nifty iron condor, one session before expiry, held to expiry
why: Legacy app research (Oct 2026): the only idea that passed its 10-year out-of-sample test was a Bank Nifty iron condor held to expiry, best entered 1 day before expiry (192 trades, +Rs 94,962 a lot, PF 1.25, worst -Rs 22,088). Tanu re-tests it on real 1-minute option prices with strict fills and costs. Shorts 1% out, wings 2% out.
source: Legacy Stockway research (roadmap parts E-I), Mandeep 13 Nov 2026
